priority_hierarchy: Priority 1 (Hard Gate): Physical validity R_val == 1.0 (exact bounds on theta, alpha, beta)
Priority 2 (Hard Gate): Zero observed aborts abort_count == 0 across all validation runs
Priority 3 (Anti-Collapse Guard): std_theta_rad >= 0.003 rad when probe candidates >= 4
Priority 4 (Screening Gate): Feasibility yield Y_feas >= 0.80 (Wilson 95% UCB <= Q_budget)
Priority 5 (Primary Objective): Maximize mean mutual information on feasible policies I_feas
lexicographic_best.tie_breaker: Higher feasibility yield Y_feas, then lower abort_rate
lexicographic_best.null_policy_handling: Null policies are strictly excluded from mutual information numerator and denominator (I_AE(Null) = 0.0)

zero_qualified_behavior.action: cgan_m4a_lexicographic_best.pt is NOT created; anchor checkpoints are used for post-hoc analysis

max_feasibility_best.purpose: Pareto anchor representing maximum operational stealth

max_information_best.purpose: Pareto anchor representing maximum intelligence extraction

balanced_pareto_best.objective: Maximize scalar trade-off product S = Y_feas * I_feas
balanced_pareto_best.purpose: Automated operational compromise on the empirical trade-off surface

full_pareto_frontier.definition: Non-dominated set of (Y_feas, I_feas) pairs where candidate A dominates B iff Y_A >= Y_B and I_A >= I_B and (Y_A > Y_B or I_A > I_B)
full_pareto_frontier.storage: Serialized in full into results/milestone4a/cgan_m4a_training_history.json under metadata.pareto_frontier
full_pareto_frontier.separation_from_scalar: The full frontier preserves all mutually non-dominated models without arbitrary scalar scalarization weights

zero_feasible_policies_behavior.outcome: All candidate metrics set to 0.0; no checkpoint qualified under lexicographic gate
